title: TECHNO 2026
description: The official welcoming party for new HIMTI members. Get to know the community, meet fellow informatics students, and kick off your journey with HIMTI.
what_to_prepare: Bring your BINUS ID card and enthusiasm!

title: TECHFEST 2026
description: National scale IT competition. Compete with the best talents across Indonesia in various technology challenges — from competitive programming to UI/UX design.
what_to_prepare: Laptop, stable internet connection, and your creativity

title: TECHTALK: Beyond the Campus Lab
description: Part of TECHFEST 2026. Theme: 'Beyond the Campus Lab: Bridging Academy Code to Industry Reality'. Explore how academic knowledge translates to real-world industry practice.
speaker: Yoel Gogo
what_to_prepare: Zoom installed, come with questions for the speaker

title: HISHOT 2026 — Seminar: To the Clouds
description: Part of HISHOT 2026. Theme: 'To the Clouds'. A deep dive into cloud computing, DevOps, and modern infrastructure. Learn from industry experts about building and scaling applications in the cloud.
speaker: Dhiams Wahyu & David S.Kom

title: HISHOT 2026 — Workshop: Cloud Deployment
description: Part of HISHOT 2026. Hands-on workshop on cloud deployment. Learn to deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS. Practical session with live coding.
speaker: Edoeardo Setiawan & Dapid Candra
what_to_prepare: Laptop with Docker installed, stable internet

title: HISHOT 2026 — Workshop: CI/CD Pipeline
description: Part of HISHOT 2026. Learn to build and automate CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. From code commit to production deployment — automate it all.
speaker: Edoeardo Setiawan & Dapid Candra
what_to_prepare: Laptop, GitHub account, basic terminal knowledge
